content.title: Important Dates and Deadlines | SXSW EDU
content.text: March 9, 2026 SXSW EDU: March 9-12, 2026 in Austin, TX Attend the 2026 SXSW EDU Conference & Festival! From March 9-12, experience unparalleled discovery, learning, professional development, and networking with education professionals from around the world. The event features conference sessions, film screenings, competitions, networking opportunities, an Expo and much more. February 23, 2026 SXSW EDU Reservations Skip the walk-up lines with reservations! New for 2026, your SXSW EDU badge allows you to hold up to two (2) reservations per day for Keynote Sessions, Featured Sessions, Workshops, plus more. Starting Monday, February 23 at 9:00am CT, you can secure your spot in advance and make the most of your experience. October 1, 2025 Registration Opens Register and book your hotel for SXSW EDU 2026 from March 9-12. September 30, 2025 Film Application Closes This is your final chance to submit your film to be screened as a part of the SXSW EDU 2026 Film Program. August 5, 2025 Film Application Opens Submit your film to be screened as a part of the SXSW EDU 2026 Film Program. July 27, 2025 PanelPicker® Entry Closes This is your final chance to submit your session proposals for the SXSW EDU 2026 event.
